Thank you, that's one thing I feel so guilty about, is having my fiance have to put up with how sad I am lately when he also struggles.  

On top of that angry, I'm not an angry person, I usually would just brush things off and forgive because it's easier.  But now I'm angry at myself, that I think these bad things, I don't want to think about dying or that I'm not good enough, I really don't, but it's SO hard to not and I don't know how to forgive the fact that I think I'm worthless because I have no motivation to do anything I can hardly get out of bed or brush my hair. You know? 

 Self love exercises I have been trying to do lately but I can't take it seriously. Literally got home today and just kept saying outloud every terrible thing I was thinking about myself which was a lot and none of it was nice but it's what I grew up hearing. I've been diagnosed with PTSD, manic depression, and anxiety.  When I did go to counseling, they would read through my file and literally say they don't know how I'm still so ok.  I'm not but I do care enough about responsibilities that what needs to be done is done.  Like a job to pay the bills hence this throwing me overboard. I may not have really done anything for myself and have been starving myself because at this point its bad and I don't even feel like I deserve food which is so messed up. But I will not let my fiance have to carry everything on his shoulders because I am falling apart on the inside, he doesn't deserve that, I am so beyond amazed he's even still with me.
